authority: Durable release-level exit contract for the whole corpus. It supersedes any reading of current-input computational exhaustion as corpus completion.
completionDefinition: The corpus is complete only as a dated saturation claim under a declared search protocol: every generated physics-mathematics adjacency is dispositioned, every terminal branch has had its nearest reopening neighbourhood swept, every experiment has executable build/bridge/physics decision gates and outcome propagation, and the theory, literature, implication, narrative, retrieval, provenance and reproducible-release gates all pass together.
nonClaims: Completion does not mean that nature or mathematics has no unknown structure.
A zero corpus-ready finite-task count is an intermediate stopping condition, not corpus completion.
Graph centrality, PageRank, retrieval rank and document count are navigation evidence, not scientific truth.
An external blocker counts as a classified frontier only after its searched neighbourhood, exact missing datum and reopening trigger are recorded.

gates.name: Physics-mathematics adjacency saturation
gates.exit: Every in-scope object or normalized topic has been crossed with every applicable adjacency family; every generated candidate has exactly one typed disposition, evidence receipt, consequence and reopening trigger; an independent verifier finds no missing or multiply classified edge.
gates.missingArtifact: The normalized topic layer is complete: all 518 candidates are dispositioned. The object expansion inventories 2,895 objects, types 1,242 exclusions, maps 1,653 scientific objects into 51,762 object-topic-family claims and leaves no unmapped object or collapsed disposition conflict. EXIT-01 remains open while 220 lead/context-only semantic routes receive independent review; 137 weak routes have received authored evidence-bearing review and one was retyped to its separate theological programme, while title-strong routes and every generated claim cell pass the structural verifier.

gates.name: Exhausted-end neighbourhood saturation
gates.exit: Every closed, killed, blocked or exhausted branch has a terminal certificate covering all required neighbourhood moves, inherited downstream consequences and the minimal datum that would reopen it.
gates.missingArtifact: None for the current terminal universe: all 80 checks across ten closed or blocked topics have evidence, findings, inherited consequences and exact reopening data. Regeneration automatically reopens EXIT-02 if another terminal topic appears.

gates.name: Experimental programme closure
gates.exit: Every experimentally reachable topic has a realistic programme containing every required field and all three decision layers; every outcome updates named claims and topics; every programme has an executable verifier or an explicit external readiness gate.
gates.missingArtifact: None for EXIT-03: all 21 programmes and all 378 required cells are explicit, including build, bridge and physics decisions, replication, release and claim propagation. Corpus completion remains forbidden while any other exit gate is open.

gates.name: Theory and mathematics closure
gates.exit: Every theoretical bridge records types, units, assumptions, maps, preserved and lost structure, invariants, limits, counterexamples, equivalence freedom, physical non-implications and an independent verification route; genuine open problems are separated from finite missing work.
gates.missingArtifact: A claim-level theory-bridge audit that tests mathematical and physical typing rather than only open-gate vocabulary.

gates.name: Literature-frontier saturation
gates.exit: Every major branch has a dated reproducible search receipt containing databases, queries and synonyms, backward and forward citation searches, neighbouring disciplines, strongest support and opposition, present bounds, conflicts and the precise residual novelty claim.
gates.missingArtifact: A branch-complete literature search register with negative-search receipts and update dates.

gates.name: Claim implication and defeat closure
gates.exit: Every authoritative claim states why it has its exact form, what it implies and does not imply, what defeats it, which assumptions support it and which downstream claims change under each outcome; propagation is machine-auditable.
gates.missingArtifact: A claim implication/defeat graph with typed upstream and downstream propagation rules.

gates.name: Standalone narrative closure
gates.exit: Authoritative standalone routes preserve Jordan admission, Lie transport and the typed realizability middle; introduce things before names; explain reasons, nearest alternatives, pictures, open/closed status and implications; and quarantine optional speculation, myth and theology without sterilizing practical hope.
gates.missingArtifact: A narrative lint and sampled human-readable audit across every authoritative standalone surface.

gates.name: Documentation, linking and retrieval closure
gates.exit: No authoritative object is orphaned or ambiguously governed; all internal links, generated surfaces, hashes and provenance are current; duplicate and contradiction audits pass; held-out retrieval works across mathematics, physics, experiment and ordinary language; centrality is explicitly non-authoritative and minority/new branches remain discoverable.
gates.missingArtifact: A unified release gate joining link integrity, authority, contradiction/duplicate audits, PageRank bias checks and stratified held-out retrieval thresholds.

gates.name: Adversarial reproducible release
gates.exit: A frozen clean checkout regenerates every derived artifact, passes all tests and verifiers, survives independent overclaim/type-change and random provenance audits, records external blockers and reopening triggers, and emits a dated release certificate whose corpus identity matches every included receipt.
gates.missingArtifact: A clean-checkout release orchestrator, adversarial audit register and signed completion certificate.
